dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Wow, those clouds are very dark.
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ, ðoʊz ˈklaʊdz ər ˈvɛri ˈdɑːrk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's going to rain. Let's go to the café.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈreɪn. ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ tə ðə kæˈfeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, but I have a raincoat in my bag.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, bʌt aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈreɪnkoʊt ɪn maɪ ˈbæɡ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Is it always like this in the rainy season?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ɪt ˈɔːlweɪz laɪk ˈðɪs ɪn ðə ˈreɪni ˌsiːzən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. In the rainy season, it rains almost every afternoon.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪn ðə ˈreɪni ˌsiːzən, ɪt ˈreɪnz ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈɛvri ˌæftərˈnuːn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no! I'm going to get wet. Let's run!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈɡɛt ˈwɛt. ˈlɛts ˈrʌn!
